Everything checks out. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Summary

**Added a new sheet "Lookup Check"** with the following layout:

| Cell | Content | Type |
|------|---------|------|
| A1 | `"Record ID"` | Label (text) |
| B1 | `51064` | Value (number) |
| A2 | `"Matched Factor"` | Label (text) |
| B2 | `=VLOOKUP(TEXT(B1,0),Sheet2!A:L,12,FALSE)` | Formula |

The formula in B2 mirrors the lookup pattern already used in Sheet1's A2 cell — it converts B1 to text via `TEXT(B1,0)` to match the text-formatted key in Sheet2 column A (`"51064"`), then performs the VLOOKUP against Sheet2 columns A:L, returning column L (the factor value `1.865463778313135e-05` for record 51064).

**Verification:**
- ✅ `safexl_verify` returned verdict **"intact"** with no lost features
- The new cell B2 shows `value: null` with the formula stored — this is expected since SafeXL doesn't calculate formulas; they compute when the workbook is opened in Excel/LibreOffice (the file is flagged for recalculation on open)
- All 14 other parts of the workbook are byte-identical to the original
